defects.what_goes_wrong: core adds to x before anything checks x is a number, so a string raises.
defects.fix: Refuse a non-number with a message before the addition.

defects.what_goes_wrong: helper multiplies by two where the contract adds two, so every total built on it is too large.
util returns one constant whatever it is asked, so no caller can tell two calls apart.
defects.fix: Return a value derived from the call.

defects.what_goes_wrong: main returns 0 whether or not it did anything, so a caller cannot see a failure.
defects.fix: Return non-zero when no work was done.

defects.what_goes_wrong: No test constructs a negative y, so the branch helper has for one is unexercised.
